_readme: Prompt data for music/generate.py. Every day is dark cinematic hybrid, the style Tyler picked from Music test run 5 on 2026-10-20 (prompt2_take1: dark cinematic hybrid, 120 BPM, pounding low drums, distorted cello ostinato, deep braams, intense and relentless, huge and gritty). The pillar is (days since start_date) mod 3, in pillar_order. Each day picks one style, one bpm, two or three instruments, one mood for that day's pillar, and one texture, seeded by the date, so tracks stay in this style but differ day to day. Keep everything English, no artist names, no song titles, no vocals.
